explanation: The English article says Russia and France entered the war united by the treaty of alliance. It says that alliance shaped the course and the outcome of the war, because it forced Germany to fight on two fronts from the first days, which led to the defeat at the First Battle of the Marne and the collapse of the Schlieffen Plan. The article puts the alliance among the causes of the shape the war took. It leaves it out of the causes of the outbreak.
